situation: Imagine you are Salim/Salma. You noticed that most students in your school use plastic bags instead of reusable shopping bags.
task: Write a formal email to your teacher asking him or her to give advice for students about using reusable shopping bags.
bullets: Why reusable shopping bags are important.
How plastic bags harm the environment.
How students can encourage others to use reusable shopping bags.
model:
Dear Mr Hilal,

I hope this email finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing this email to ask you to give students some advice about using reusable shopping bags.

First, reusable shopping bags are important because we can use them many times. For example, one bag can replace hundreds of plastic bags. Moreover, they save money.

Second, plastic bags harm the environment because they take hundreds of years to break down. For example, they can kill sea animals. Moreover, students can encourage others to use reusable bags by making posters.

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to your response. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Yours sincerely,
Salim

situation: Imagine you are Salim/Salma. Your teacher has selected you to participate in the cultural week at your school.
task: Write a formal email to your school magazine talking about Omani culture.
model:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope this email finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing this email to tell you about Omani culture.

First, Oman has many famous historical places. For example, Nizwa Fort and Bahla Fort show the history of our country. Moreover, many tourists visit them every year.

Second, traditional Omani food and clothes are very special. For example, people enjoy shuwa and halwa, and men wear the dishdasha and the kumma, while women wear colourful dresses. Moreover, Omani people always welcome guests with coffee and dates.

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to your response. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Yours faithfully,
Salim

situation: Imagine you are Sami/Samia. Your friend Alex/Alice is a student who spends too much time on social media and always feels distracted. He/She needs help to use social media in a better way.
task: Write an email to your friend Alex/Alice giving advice on how to reduce screen time and use social media wisely.
model:
Dear Alex,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to give you some advice about using social media in a better way.

First, you should reduce your screen time. For example, you can set a timer and stop after one hour. Moreover, you should keep your phone in another room when you study.

Second, you should use social media wisely. However, you should not follow accounts that waste your time. Therefore, follow pages that teach you something useful.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Sami

situation: Imagine you are Ali/Alia. Your friend Salim/Salma wants to start a new blog, but he/she needs ideas.
task: Write an email to your friend Salim/Salma. In your email include the following:
bullets: Suggest a topic for the blog (e.g. technology, hobbies, or school life).
Explain why this is a good idea.
Give advice on how to make the blog successful.
model:
Dear Salim,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to give you some ideas about your new blog.

First, I suggest that you write about technology. For example, you can review new apps and games. Moreover, you can write short tips.

Second, this is a good idea because many students like reading about technology. To make your blog successful, you should post every week. Therefore, readers will visit it again. However, you should always check your spelling.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Ali

situation: Imagine you are Ahmed/Basma. Your friend John/Julia is worried about climate change because the weather is becoming hotter and he/she wants to know what to do.
task: Write an email to your friend John/Julia explaining what climate change is, describing its effects, and giving advice on how he/she can help the environment.
model:
Dear John,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to explain climate change to you and give you some advice.

First, climate change is a long-term change in the Earth's weather. For example, the Earth is becoming hotter because people burn oil, gas and coal. Moreover, cars add more gases to the air.

Second, climate change has serious effects, such as melting ice and rising sea levels. However, you can help the environment. Therefore, you should save electricity and plant trees.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Ahmed

situation: Imagine you are Sameer/Samira. Your friend Nasser/Nasra wants to start an environmental campaign at school, but he/she needs ideas.
task: Write an email to your friend Nasser/Nasra. In your email include the following:
bullets: Suggest a campaign idea (e.g. recycling, saving energy, reducing plastic).
Explain why this campaign is important.
Give advice on how to make the campaign successful.
model:
Dear Nasser,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to give you some ideas about your environmental campaign.

First, I suggest a recycling campaign. For example, students can put paper and plastic bottles in different bins. Moreover, each class can have its own recycling box.

Second, this campaign is important because it reduces waste and protects nature. However, a campaign needs good planning. Therefore, you should ask teachers to help you and make colourful posters for the school.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Sameer

situation: Imagine you are Salim/Salimah. Your friend Tom/Tina is a student who is writing about renewable energy but doesn't know much about it.
task: Write an email to your friend Tom/Tina explaining what renewable energy is, giving examples in Oman, and giving advice on why people should use it.
model:
Dear Tom,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to explain renewable energy to you.

First, renewable energy is energy from natural sources that never finish, such as the sun and the wind. For example, solar panels change sunlight into electricity. Moreover, wind turbines use the wind to make power.

Second, Oman already uses solar power stations and a wind farm in Dhofar. Therefore, I advise people to use renewable energy. Moreover, it is clean and safe.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Salim

situation: Imagine you are Saleh/Sara. Your friend Majid/Muna wants to design a new invention but doesn't know how to start.
task: Write an email to your friend Majid/Muna suggesting an invention, explaining how it works, and giving advice on how it can help people or the environment.
model:
Dear Majid,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to suggest an idea for your new invention.

First, I suggest that you invent a solar phone charger. For example, it can have a small solar panel on top. Moreover, the panel changes sunlight into electricity, so people can charge their phones outside.

Second, your invention can help people and the environment. For example, hikers can charge phones in the desert. Moreover, it uses clean energy, so it protects the environment.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Saleh

situation: Imagine you are Fahad/Farah. Your friend Mazin/Muzna is preparing a project about famous Omani people but doesn't know who to write about.
task: Write an email to your friend Mazin/Muzna suggesting one Omani person, explaining what this person is famous for, and giving advice on how to make the project more interesting.
model:
Dear Mazin,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to give you an idea for your project about famous Omani people.

First, I suggest that you write about Sultan Qaboos. For example, he was the leader of Oman for fifty years. Moreover, everyone in Oman knows his name.

Second, he is famous for building schools, hospitals and roads across Oman. However, you should not write only facts. Therefore, add old photos and ask your grandparents how life changed.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Fahad

situation: Imagine you are Basim/Basma. Your friend Paul/Amelia is a student writing about ancient civilisations but doesn't know which one to choose.
task: Write an email to your friend Paul/Amelia describing one civilisation, explaining why it is important to write about this civilisation, and giving advice on what fact he/she should include.
model:
Dear Paul,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to give you an idea about your project on ancient civilisations.

First, I suggest that you write about Ancient Egypt. For example, this civilisation grew along the River Nile. Moreover, the Egyptians built the pyramids.

Second, this civilisation is important because we can still learn from it about building and writing. However, you should not include too many facts. Therefore, choose one clear fact, such as how the pyramids were built.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Basim
